# BuildBuddy Framework

Apply the following buildbuddy framework guidance to the code or configuration you are changing. Check the stated preconditions and preserve behavior outside the authorized scope.

- Skill: `buildbuddy`
- Source of truth: `$CODEX_HOME/plugins/gitlab/skills/buildbuddy/SKILL.md`
- Runtime agent config: `$CODEX_HOME/plugins/gitlab/skills/buildbuddy/agents/openai.yaml`
- Supporting docs: `$CODEX_HOME/plugins/gitlab/skills/buildbuddy/references/`
